sfx.whoosh: fast cartoon whoosh ~0.4s: camera whip-pan, quick move, object flying past
sfx.whoosh_long: long swooping whoosh ~0.9s: big swoop, chapter card fly-in, big camera move
sfx.whoosh_up: rising whoosh ~0.6s: launch upward, fly up, big jump
sfx.swish: tiny quick swish ~0.15s: hand gesture, small flick, card flip, head turn
sfx.zoom_in: quick tonal 'zwip' punch-in ~0.3s (snap zoom on a face)
sfx.riser: tension riser, 2.0s long; START it 2.0s BEFORE the peak moment
sfx.riser_long: long tension riser, 4.0s long; START it 4.0s BEFORE the peak moment
sfx.reverse_swell: reverse-cymbal swell, 1.5s long; START it 1.5s BEFORE the moment it should peak
sfx.impact: cinematic boom impact with tail ~2s: big reveal, title slam, transformation
sfx.boom: deep comedic 'vine boom' bass hit ~1.5s: dramatic/comedic emphasis on a face or a punchline
sfx.sub_drop: low sub-bass drop ~1.5s: heavy moment, landing of something huge
sfx.record_scratch: vinyl record scratch ~0.6s (freeze frame / 'yep, that's me' moment). Pair with music out:'scratch'
sfx.tap: finger tap on a touch screen
sfx.ui_pop: UI panel / toast / popup appears (soft pop + blip)
sfx.money_counter: rapid ticking of a number counter rolling up, ~1s (repeat entries for longer)
sfx.step: one footstep, hard surface (prefer the 'footsteps' list for walks/runs)
sfx.thud: body hits the ground / heavy thud
sfx.bonk: cartoon head bonk on a hard object
sfx.body_fall: big fall to the ground with a bounce
sfx.cloth: clothing rustle (big arm gesture, turning around)
sfx.fall_whistle: long descending whistle ~1.6s (falling from a height)
sfx.blush: soft rising 'bwoop' as a face turns red
sfx.shine: single bright 'ting' glint (sunglasses glint, star glint)
sfx.drumroll: snare drum roll 2s ending with a cymbal crash (START it 2s before the reveal)
sfx.portal_enter: jumping into a portal: whoosh + shimmer ~1s
sfx.stone: stone scrape / rock shuffles (pet rock moving)
sfx.censor_bleep: TV censor bleep tone ~0.35s (over a filtered word)
sfx.steam_hiss: steam hiss / kettle puff ~1s (steam off a red face)
sfx.vhs_clunk: VHS deck mechanical clunk (play / rewind button)

ambience.town: busy blocky town: distant traffic + birds
ambience.kitchen: kitchen room tone with a light fridge hum
ambience.vault_hum: sci-fi machine hum inside the vault
ambience.conveyor: conveyor belt motor hum + soft rattle

moods.hook: upbeat bright pop main theme (cold open, title, outro)
moods.mystery: night, curious, music box + soft pad
moods.adventure: bright orchestral-pop wonder, exploring a new world
moods.epic: big epic tension (choice of destiny, vault reveal)
moods.game: cheerful chiptune in-game music (Steal an Egg)
moods.cool: Nova's theme: cool groovy hip-hop beat
moods.climax: intense final race against the clock
moods.outro: upbeat reprise of the main theme
